code_read: Full dispatcher, synthetic tests and executed dependency definitions/imports read; unused dependency CLI render routes not invoked.
checked_contracts: Six bounded exact Fraction values must equal complete occupied-bounds alignment; actual metadata independently gives [1187/116,0,-201/29,0,507/50,-154/5]. No arbitrary shear, offset search or crop is accepted.

Logical32x32/origin0/full128x128 export; decoder canvas, parent PNG size and declared Source/raw occupied bounds checked. Rational values cannot admit float, bool, NaN, infinity or zero/negative denominators.
Pillow bicubic inverse transform uses transparent exterior, not edge clamping; returned coverage is actual Scale2x twice of Source. Independent scalar Scale2x reference reproduces gap/corner support.
c612 fill seeds are immutable trusted-and-supported parent samples; radius12 is Euclidean, includes squared144 and rejects outside-circle candidates. Fills never become new donors.
Fill prefers a donor with the same Source label within radius, otherwise it may use another Source label. Deterministic tie order is distance/y/x. This is not a guarantee of material suitability.

Exactly two disjoint sorted33-cell groups receive f807 full actual Original Scale4 RGBA, including local transparent samples. All66 cells must be painted Source and total66 must remain at most a quarter of painted cells.

Independent palette perturbation proves Source RGB changes cannot affect unselected generated-body pixels; alpha and all undeclared RGBA remain exact. Original66 cells are explicitly no generated-HD credit.

Outside the retained groups, at least half the complete supported body must be direct resampled generated RGB, unchanged by fill/retention. At least one fully supported interior block must contain detail; this weak sanity check is not artistic acceptance.

All three dependency payload hashes are checked before compile/exec in fresh namespaces; already-verified dependency imports are routed to those modules and sys.path mutations stay in a private proxy. Buffered Source/palette/parent bytes are processed without path reopening.

Canonical relative descriptor reads reject traversal, symlink files/directories and wrong hashes; bounded regular-file size, descriptor identity/mtime and post-read hash are checked. Changed-during-read synthetic input stops.

The disk floor precedes dependency/art reads. All checks/render/encode precede staging; payloads are fsynced then Linux renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE publishes one direct-child directory. Existing output, symlink/race and write/rename failures do not overwrite inputs or unrelated paths.
limitations: Actual parent/Source/palette payloads were byte-hashed for custody only, never decoded or rendered by this reviewer. Numerical generation/detail guards do not decide warning rhythm, body layout, material quality or native readability.

Affine resampling, Source-derived alpha, bounded generated-donor fills and retained Original RGB produce DERIVED artwork. They must not be relabeled as untouched generation or prove old HOLDs resolved.

The helper is the exact frozen Linux private utility; no generic decoder sandbox, concurrent-writer or crash-durability claim is made beyond the frozen regular-file custody and stated no-replace install.
authority: Return to Root. Actual cleanup remains unexecuted and requires Root activation plus the named ownership/custody confirmation. A CODE pass supplies no art/QA/context/admission approval.
custody: Producer handoff declares all owned/named inputs frozen with no pending writer/call/lease; 25 exact pins independently checked before/after tests and again at seal. Reviewer owns only this private evidence; no pending reviewer operation after sealing.
